name: Refresh Dashboard TMO - Publi Mature BR
_comment: ANTES DE IMPORTAR: substitua os 3 placeholders abaixo

_placeholders.DOC_ID: ID do seu documento Grid  (URL: https://grid.adminml.com/d/<DOC_ID>/view)
_placeholders.ID_CREDENCIAL_GCP: ID da credencial GCP no VerdiFlow (ex: 'Abc123XyZ')
_placeholders.NOME_CREDENCIAL_GCP: Nome da credencial GCP no VerdiFlow (ex: 'GCP - bidata')

parameters.sqlQuery:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    USER_LDAP                   AS rep,
    USER_TEAM_LEADER_LDAP       AS lider,
    USER_SENIORITY              AS seniority,
    USER_TEAM_CHANNEL           AS canal,
    SUM(DENOMINATOR_TMO)        AS vol,
    ROUND(
      SUM(NUMERATOR_TMO) / SUM(DENOMINATOR_TMO)
    , 2)                        AS tmo_min
  FROM `pdme000131-zk9vntjdxcq-furyid.TBL.BT_CX_REP_METRICS_CS`
  WHERE DATE_ID BETWEEN
          DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE('America/Sao_Paulo'), MONTH)
      AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('America/Sao_Paulo'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    AND USER_TEAM_NAME IN (
          'BR_Publicaciones_Sellers_Mature',
          'HSP_Publicaciones_Sellers_Mature'
        )
    AND USER_TEAM_CHANNEL IN ('MULTICANAL CHAT', 'MULTICANAL C2C')
    AND USER_TEAM_LEADER_LDAP IN (
          'alicarvalho', 'bkaroline', 'isabmot',
          'thaidossanto', 'lrossetto'
        )
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
  HAVING SUM(DENOMINATOR_TMO) >= 30
),
deduped AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY rep
      ORDER BY vol DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  rep,
  lider,
  seniority,
  canal,
  CAST(vol AS INT64)                                     AS vol,
  tmo_min,
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', CURRENT_DATE('America/Sao_Paulo')) AS month_key
FROM deduped
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY canal, tmo_min
